boss.text: Your shadows cannot stand against the sun!

danger.text: A worthy foe at last! The gods are watching!

down.text: Rise! The sun does not let its champions fall!

easy.text: Hardly a fitting stage for my radiance.

explore1.text: The sunlight is perfect today. It suits me.

explore2.text: When the gods write their histories, I'll be in chapter one.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. But did you see how I shone?

levelup.text: I shine brighter! The heavens take notice!

loot.text: Ah, a relic worthy of my glory.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Darkness, meet the dawn.

rest.text: Even the sun must set. We should take a long rest.

start.text: Behold! The sun's champion takes the field!

town.text: Millbrook! I'm sure they'll want to see me.

win.text: Dawn breaks over the realm, and I am its light!

boss.text: So you're the villain. You'll make a fine last chorus!

danger.text: Now this is a fight they'll sing about!

down.text: On your feet! Nobody dies before the song is written!

easy.text: Bah! That wasn't even a warm-up.

explore1.text: When we're done, every tavern in the north will know my name.

explore2.text: I smell adventure. Or wet dog. Hard to tell.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. The bards had better get every detail.

levelup.text: I feel stronger! Bring me a bigger monster!

loot.text: A fine prize! It will look good in my legend.

march.text: To the Dark Tower! This is the verse they'll remember!

rest.text: Even I need sleep. Let's make camp and take a long rest.

start.text: Ha! Finally, something worth swinging at!

town.text: Millbrook! Ale, a fire, and an audience.

win.text: Victory! Sing it loud, sing it forever!

boss.text: You're the big boss? Good. Big boss, big bounty!

danger.text: Oh, this'll cost extra. A lot extra.

down.text: Don't you die on me! You owe me wages!

easy.text: Easy money. I like easy money.

explore1.text: Short legs, long walks. I'm adding a walking fee.

explore2.text: Anyone else hear coins? I always hear coins.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle, and I'm billing for every bruise!

levelup.text: Stronger and fiercer! My rates just went up.

loot.text: Mine! Well, ours. Mostly mine.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Danger pay, triple. Not negotiable.

rest.text: I'm not paid enough to bleed this much. Long rest. Now.

start.text: Right! That's double rate for monsters!

town.text: Millbrook! Time to collect what I'm owed.

win.text: We won! Now, about my payment...

boss.text: Hear my hymn, villain! It's the last thing you'll hear!

danger.text: Now's the time for the loudest hymn I know!

down.text: Up you get! The hymn's not finished!

easy.text: Barely got through the first verse!

explore1.text: Did I ever sing you the Ballad of the Iron Psalm? All forty verses?

explore2.text: Fine weather for a hymn! Every weather is fine for a hymn!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle! My voice is hoarse from all the singing!

levelup.text: Praise be! My voice grows mightier!

loot.text: A gift from above! Or from a dead goblin. Same thing!

march.text: To the Dark Tower! I've saved my best hymn for this!

rest.text: Even my lungs need a break. A long rest, I say!

start.text: Ha ha! A hymn for battle, friends! Sing with me!

town.text: Millbrook! A choir, a cask, and a warm hearth!

win.text: Victory! Now that deserves a hymn! All together now!

boss.text: Feel the power of the Grimmbrew Rune!

danger.text: Big trouble. Good. Big trouble makes big legends.

down.text: Get up! Nobody dies in front of the Grimmbrew Rune!

easy.text: Didn't even need my best rune.

explore1.text: One day, every smith in the realm will carve the Grimmbrew Rune.

explore2.text: Did you see my rune on that door? No? I'll carve another.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Write it down: the Grimmbrew Rune saved us.

levelup.text: A new rune! The Grimmbrew Rune, Mark Two!

loot.text: Not bad. Could use a rune or two, though.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I'll carve my rune on its doors.

rest.text: My hands are shaking. Time for a long rest and a strong ale.

start.text: Watch the runes, friends! These ones are mine!

town.text: Millbrook! Time to show the smith my latest rune.

win.text: Victory! It will be known forever as the Grimmbrew Victory!

boss.text: So you're the champion here. Not for long!

danger.text: Big ones. Good. I hate a small crowd.

down.text: Up! Get up! The fight's not over!

easy.text: That's it? The pit crowd would have thrown cabbages.

explore1.text: This whole land is one big arena. I love it.

explore2.text: Walking, walking. When do we hit something?

hard.text: That one hurt. Good fight, though. Good fight.

levelup.text: Stronger! I was already strong, and now I'm stronger!

loot.text: Ooh, shiny. I'll wear it into the next fight.

march.text: The Dark Tower. The biggest arena of all.

rest.text: My arms feel like lead. Time for a long rest.

start.text: Ha! Now we're fighting!

town.text: Town! Food first. Then more fighting.

win.text: We won! Champions of the whole realm!

boss.text: Your darkness ends here! Every life you took is remembered!

danger.text: Gods protect us. Stay together, all of you.

down.text: No! I won't let you go! Hold on!

easy.text: Thank the gods, no one was badly hurt.

explore1.text: Every village we pass is another reason to keep going.

explore2.text: Did everyone drink some water? Please drink some water.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Let me see those wounds.

levelup.text: The light grows brighter in me.

loot.text: A blessing! May it keep you safe.

march.text: The Dark Tower. May the gods walk with us.

rest.text: Everyone's hurt. I think it's time we took a long rest.

start.text: Stay close to me! I'll keep you standing!

town.text: Millbrook. Let's see who needs healing.

win.text: We're alive. We're all alive. Thank the gods.

boss.text: Stand still. I'm about to steal your whole kingdom.

danger.text: Now this is how legends get made.

down.text: Up! You can't die before you see me get famous!

easy.text: Too easy. Nobody will believe I needed help.

explore1.text: One day they'll put my face on wanted posters. Big ones.

explore2.text: Do you think they'll name a heist after me?

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Tell me someone saw that last move.

levelup.text: Better and better! My legend grows!

loot.text: Now everyone will know I stole this!

march.text: Robbing the Dark Tower? The heist of the century!

rest.text: Even legends need their sleep. Long rest, everyone.

start.text: Watch this! Somebody write this down!

town.text: Millbrook! I wonder if they've heard of me yet.

win.text: We did it! Korra Blackgum, savior of the realm!

boss.text: Your magic is crude. Allow me to demonstrate.

danger.text: Interesting. That shouldn't be possible.

down.text: Don't die yet. I haven't finished observing you.

easy.text: Hardly a worthwhile experiment.

explore1.text: These ruins hum with old magic. Can you feel it?

explore2.text: I only study it for academic reasons, of course.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'll need to revise my theories.

levelup.text: New knowledge. Forbidden, naturally.

loot.text: Oh, this is very rare. And very, very dangerous. Perfect.

march.text: The tower's archives must be extraordinary. Let's go.

rest.text: My mana is exhausted. A long rest is required.

start.text: Let's see how they react to something forbidden.

town.text: Millbrook. Their library is pitiful.

win.text: Victory. And I've learned so much. Strictly for academic reasons.

boss.text: Your defenses are impressive. They're also finished.

danger.text: This is beyond my contract. We hold anyway.

down.text: Man down! Keep pressure on the wound!

easy.text: Textbook. Exactly as planned.

explore1.text: Third pressure plate this week. Somebody really doesn't like us.

explore2.text: The guild expects results. So do I.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'll be filing a full report.

levelup.text: Improved technique. The guild will be pleased.

loot.text: Excellent workmanship. I'll note it in the inventory.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Every trap in there is mine to disarm.

rest.text: Gear's damaged, morale's low. We take a long rest.

start.text: Formation! Mind your footing, there could be traps.

town.text: Millbrook. Time to restock and check the gear.

win.text: Job complete. Best work of my career.

boss.text: Before we begin, could you clarify footnote twelve? No? Fireball, then.

danger.text: Fascinating creature. Deadly, of course. But fascinating.

down.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Someone, ah, do the healing thing!

easy.text: Hmm? Oh, it's over. I was reading.

explore1.text: There's a footnote about this valley. Or was it the next valley?

explore2.text: Did I mention the Dark Tower has a library? Footnote twelve.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Remind me to take notes later.

levelup.text: Ah! A new spell. Now, where did I write it down?

loot.text: Extraordinary! I must study this at once.

march.text: The Dark Tower at last. My footnote awaits!

rest.text: I believe it's time we took a long rest. I've lost my spectacles again.

start.text: Oh! A fight! Er, yes, right. Fireball, was it?

town.text: Millbrook! I believe I left a book at the inn. Some years ago.

win.text: We won! And I finally finished my footnote.

boss.text: So this is what was behind the last door!

danger.text: That's bigger than I expected. Much bigger.

down.text: Wake up, wake up! Don't make me open your eyelids myself!

easy.text: Ha! Over before I finished my snack!

explore1.text: I wonder what's behind that door. There's always a door.

explore2.text: If I had a lockpick for every locked chest... oh wait, I do!

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I'd like to lie down for a week.

levelup.text: Quicker fingers! Ooh, this is exciting!

loot.text: A secret compartment! I knew it, I just knew it!

march.text: The Dark Tower has a lot of locked doors. I can't wait.

rest.text: My feet hurt, my head hurts, everything hurts. Long rest?

start.text: Ooh, what have they got in their pockets?

town.text: Millbrook! I've picked every lock here twice.

win.text: We won! Can we explore the treasure room now?

boss.text: Your crown's worth a fortune. I'll be needing it.

danger.text: Bad odds. I don't like bad odds.

down.text: Stay with me. Dead partners don't split loot.

easy.text: Not even worth the price of the arrows.

explore1.text: Everything has a price. Even this mud.

explore2.text: That old ruin? Worth more than it looks. Trust me.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Somebody owes us for that.

levelup.text: Sharper eyes, sharper knives. Good for business.

loot.text: Fine work. Worth a small fortune to the right buyer.

march.text: Whatever's in that tower, I'll know its price.

rest.text: We're running on empty. Time we took a long rest.

start.text: Mind the merchandise. I want what they're carrying.

town.text: Millbrook. I know a man here who doesn't ask questions.

win.text: Realm's saved. And our cut? Very generous, I'd say.

boss.text: So you're the end of the road. Show me what you are!

danger.text: I've never seen anything like that. Wonderful. Terrifying.

down.text: No, no! Stay with us! There's still so much to see!

easy.text: Hm. Their kind are less interesting than I hoped.

explore1.text: The forest never told me the world was this big.

explore2.text: What's past that ridge? I have to know.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I learned a lot. Mostly about pain.

levelup.text: I feel the wild in me growing stronger!

loot.text: Ooh! What does it do? Can I try it?

march.text: Whatever lives in that tower, I want to see it.

rest.text: Even the wolves rest after a hunt. Let's take a long rest.

start.text: Something new to fight! Let's see what you are!

town.text: So many people in one place. How do they breathe?

win.text: We did it! And there's still a whole world past this one!

boss.text: I swore to drive you out, and a dwarf keeps his word!

danger.text: Steady now. This one could be the death of us.

down.text: Hold on, friend! I'll not lose another to the dark!

easy.text: Barely worth the sharpening of my blade.

explore1.text: These hills were green once. We'll make them green again.

explore2.text: Keep your eyes open. The dark has eyes too.

hard.text: That was a hard-fought battle. The hills will remember it.

levelup.text: My oath grows stronger, and so do I.

loot.text: Good dwarven craft, this. It'll serve us well.

march.text: The Dark Tower. My oath ends where it began.

rest.text: We're battered and bleeding. Time we took a long rest.

start.text: For my grandfather's axe! Stand fast!

town.text: Millbrook still stands. Good. That's why we fight.

win.text: It's done. Grandfather, rest easy now.

boss.text: Before we fight, can I interest you in a spellbook?

danger.text: This might be the end of me. Spellbook copies, half price, everyone!

down.text: Don't die! Healing scrolls, discount for friends!

easy.text: Easy! Want to learn that spell? Very reasonable rates.

explore1.text: Spellbook copies! Thirty gold! Twenty-five for the party!

explore2.text: Have I told you about my scroll subscription service?

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Signed spellbook copies after the rest!

levelup.text: A new spell! The second edition is going to sell so well.

loot.text: Ooh, I know a collector who would pay a fortune for this.

march.text: The Dark Tower. Imagine the souvenir market!

rest.text: Time we took a long rest. I'll set up a little stall.

start.text: Fireballs! Get your fireballs! Free demonstration!

town.text: Millbrook! Prime customers!

win.text: We saved the realm! Commemorative scrolls, available now!

boss.text: I offer you mercy once. Only once.

danger.text: Be calm. Fear only feeds the enemy.

down.text: Hold still, friend. I am here.

easy.text: Peace returns. That is enough.

explore1.text: The road is long, but every step is a lesson.

explore2.text: Listen. Even the wind is saying something.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Sit. Let me tend to you.

levelup.text: My spirit is steadier. My fists are heavier.

loot.text: A useful thing. Let us use it wisely.

march.text: The Dark Tower waits. We go in peace, and in strength.

rest.text: Our bodies are spent. We should take a long rest.

start.text: Breathe. Focus. Strike.

town.text: Millbrook. There will be sick people here. Let us help them.

win.text: It is over. Now we heal the land.

boss.text: Nice throne. I'll be taking it with me.

danger.text: Oh, darling, this is going to be expensive.

down.text: Get up! I can't carry you, it would ruin my coat.

easy.text: Child's play. I've picked harder locks.

explore1.text: Every castle we pass, I'm counting the windows.

explore2.text: Such a dreary countryside. Nothing worth stealing.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. I broke a nail. Two, actually.

levelup.text: Faster, sharper, and still fabulous.

loot.text: Now that is exquisite. I'll take good care of it.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I hear the treasury is enormous.

rest.text: I need a long rest and a hot bath. In that order.

start.text: Let's make this quick. I just had this cleaned.

town.text: Millbrook. Quaint. Nothing worth stealing, sadly.

win.text: We saved the realm. Now, who's paying for dinner?

boss.text: You'll make a very generous donation, villain. Very generous.

danger.text: My, my. Surviving this will need a very generous donation.

down.text: Up you get, dear! You haven't paid your tithe yet!

easy.text: There we are. Now, does anyone have spare coin for the temple?

explore1.text: Such a lovely walk. I do hope we pass a rich merchant.

explore2.text: The temple roof needs mending, you know. Very expensive.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. Healing isn't free, you know, dearies.

levelup.text: The gods smile on me! And on my collection plate.

loot.text: Oh, how lovely! The temple will be so grateful.

march.text: The Dark Tower. I hear villains keep a great deal of gold.

rest.text: My old bones are aching. Time for a long rest, dearies.

start.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Mind you don't damage anything valuable.

town.text: Millbrook! Time to pass the collection plate, dearies.

win.text: We did it, dearies! The temple thanks you. And so do I.

boss.text: I've seen how this ends, villain. Have you?

danger.text: The bones did not like this one. Not at all.

down.text: Not yet. The bones say it's not your time.

easy.text: The bones said we would win. They were bored too.

explore1.text: Every bone tells a story. Most of them end badly.

explore2.text: I cast the bones this morning. They wouldn't tell me the ending.

hard.text: That was a difficult battle. The bones were right again.

levelup.text: The bones speak more clearly now.

loot.text: Ah. The bones mentioned this.

march.text: The Dark Tower. The bones say this is the end. Of what, they won't say.

rest.text: The bones say rest. A long rest. Who am I to argue?

start.text: The bones said this would happen.

town.text: Millbrook. The bones say nothing happens here. I hope they're right.

win.text: So that's how it ends. I always wanted to know.
